scope.research_boundary: Audit only the already-linked candidate files, source records, research-attempt files, B151 scope/results, and registered campaign histories. These are the 18 B151 fields still in the fresh ready queue. Determine whether existing exact evidence supports any retained candidate value. No new web/public-post query, page open, URL retry, source creation, or external contact is in scope. Root is the sole writer. Promote a field only where an already-linked exact source supports it; otherwise convert its latest open B151 attempt to blocked with a concise exact-model reason and accepted references to existing evidence, preserving all earlier attempts and campaigns.
field_rules: Complete-bike weight must match the retained exact build and preserve size, included equipment, approximation, and weighing basis; frame weight cannot substitute.
Drivetrain evidence must establish the exact series, speeds, layout, actuation, and selected retained build.
Tire clearance requires an exact-model maximum; fitted tire size alone does not establish the maximum.
Stiffness evidence must apply to the exact target/generation and be meaningful; distinguish qualitative impressions from controlled results.
excluded: No image, price, warranty, purchase-route, UI, or unrelated catalog changes.
No external delivery, GitHub mutation, commit, push, PR, merge, publish, or production write.
